patient_persona.description: Mrs. Shanthi a/p Krishnan, 57, female, payroll clerk in Klang, Selangor; had a coronary stent in March and takes aspirin and clopidogrel. Warm, talkative Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wan Azlina Wan Ismail, Malay woman in her 40s, gastroenterologist at a Klang hospital clinic. Precise, reassuring; mostly English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning, Mrs. Shanthi. Your GP says you have pedih ulu hati for quite some time. Tell me more.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Three years already, doctor. Burning in the dada after makan, and at night masam water comes up to my throat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Does it wake you up? Any trouble swallowing, or losing weight?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wakes me up two, three times a week. Swallowing is okay, weight actually naik sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: What are you taking for it sekarang?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I buy Gaviscon from the farmasi. And my heart doctor gave me aspirin 100mg and clopidogrel 75mg after the stent.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Those two together increase the risk of stomach bleeding, so you do need proper protection. Have you had any black stools?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, never hitam. Sometimes kawan punya omeprazole I take when it's very teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please don't take omeprazole. It can reduce how well clopidogrel works, and that matters for your stent.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, I tak tahu pun. So what can I take?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll start pantoprazole 40mg, once a day, thirty minutes before breakfast. It doesn't interfere with clopidogrel the same way.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Also, jangan makan within three hours before tidur, and raise the head of your katil with blocks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dinner I always makan late, after nine. My husband balik lambat from work.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Try having a lighter dinner earlier, maybe just a small snack later. We'll book a gastroscopy since it's been three years.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Do I need to stop the ubat cair darah for the scope?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, don't stop anything without your cardiologist. For a simple diagnostic scope we can do it safely on both.

patient_persona.description: Encik Zulkarnain bin Othman, 45, male, lorry driver from Kuantan, Pahang; smokes a pack a day. Gruff, straightforward East Coast Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ravindran Pillai, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, family physician at a Kuantan klinik kesihatan. Fatherly, firm; fluent Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Zulkarnain, dah lapan minggu makan omeprazole. Macam mana pedih ulu hati?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah kurang banyak, doktor. Malam dah boleh tidur, tak rasa masam naik tekak lagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Omeprazole 20mg tu encik makan setiap pagi sebelum makan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Selalunya pagi, tapi kadang-kadang saya lupa, makan after breakfast je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Better take it before food, thirty minutes. Barulah ubat tu berkesan betul.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena makan selama-lamanya ke ubat ni, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak semestinya. Sekarang dah baik, kita cuba kurangkan. Makan bila perlu je, on demand, bila ada simptom.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, kalau pedih baru makan. Senang sikit macam tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Tapi rokok tu, encik masih hisap one pack sehari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah kurang sikit, dalam lima belas batang. Susah nak berhenti, bawak lori malam mengantuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rokok buat injap perut jadi longgar, sebab tu asid naik. Klinik ni ada program berhenti merokok, nak saya rujuk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh jugak lah, doktor. Isteri pun dah bising.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Berat encik hari ini 88 kilo, turun dua kilo. Keep it up, kurangkan teh tarik manis dan late night supper.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau pedih balik teruk macam dulu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau susah telan, muntah darah atau najis hitam, datang terus. Those are warning signs, we need to do a scope.

patient_persona.description: Tay Hui Wen, 33, female, marketing executive in Kuala Lumpur, 28 weeks pregnant with her first child. Gentle, slightly worried KL Mandarin with English workplace words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chew Boon Hock, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, obstetrician-friendly GP in Petaling Jaya. Calm, reassuring; Mandarin with English drug names.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我 pregnant 二十八个星期，最近胸口一直烧，吃完饭就很难受。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个在怀孕后期很常见，因为宝宝把胃往上推，荷尔蒙也让胃的门比较松。晚上会更严重吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，躺下去就酸水上来，有时候咳嗽醒来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有没有吐？或者右上腹痛，headache，脚肿得很厉害？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有，就是烧。脚有一点点肿，gynae 说正常。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好，你的血压 116/72，正常。我先确定不是其他问题，看起来是单纯的 reflux。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 怀孕可以吃药吗？我很怕影响 baby。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gaviscon 是 safe 的，after meals 和 before bed 各 10ml。它在胃上面形成一层 protective layer，不太进入血液。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那如果 Gaviscon 不够力呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那可以加 omeprazole 20mg，一天一次。怀孕用的研究很多，算是安全的。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Coffee 会让 reflux 更严重，最好 cut down。还有 small frequent meals，睡觉前三个钟头不要吃东西。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 咖啡会让 reflux 更严重，最好减少。还有少吃多餐，睡觉前三个钟头不要吃东西。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 睡觉的时候用多两个枕头可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，或者把床头垫高一点，sleep on your left side 也会舒服些。After delivery，通常就会好了。

patient_persona.description: Hajah Saadiah binti Ahmad, 63, female, retired school canteen operator from Alor Setar, Kedah; on long-term omeprazole. Chatty, Kedah Malay accent, slow.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Afiqah Rosli, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at an Alor Setar clinic doing a medication refill visit. Polite, clear; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Assalamualaikum doktor. Mai ambik ubat gastrik ni, dah habis minggu lepas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Waalaikumsalam, mak cik. Mak cik dah makan omeprazole ni berapa lama dah?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lama dah, lima tahun lebih. Doktor dulu kata makan terus, long-term.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sekarang ada symptom lagi? Heartburn, masam naik ke tekak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada sangat dah. Kalau makan gulai lemak banyak, baru rasa sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik, long-term PPI boleh reduce magnesium dan vitamin B12. Bone density pun boleh jadi lemah sikit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya ka? Patutlah kaki mak cik selalu kejang malam-malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mungkin ada kaitan. Hari ini saya ambil darah untuk check magnesium dan B12 sekali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya cadang kurangkan dos. Omeprazole 20mg, tapi makan selang sehari untuk dua minggu dulu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau pedih balik macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau pedih sikit, boleh minum antacid, one tablespoon after meals. Kalau teruk, sambung balik once a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik lah. Ubat darah tinggi mak cik tu pun nak ambik sekali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amlodipine 10mg, blood pressure today 132/78, very good. Saya sambung untuk tiga bulan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih doktor. Nanti result darah tu macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau ada yang tak normal, klinik akan panggil mak cik. Kalau tak, jumpa tiga bulan lagi.

patient_persona.description: Kenneth Khoo Beng Huat, 40, male, factory production manager in Bayan Lepas, Penang. English-dominant Penang Chinese, brisk, some Hokkien-style particles and Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nadia Ramli, Malay woman in her 40s, gastroenterologist at a Penang private hospital, reviewing scope results. Clear, structured; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kenneth, I have your gastroscopy report here. Let me show you the pictures.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doc. Serious or not? I was a bit takut the whole week.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nothing cancerous. You have reflux oesophagitis, LA grade B, meaning a few small erosions at the bottom of the food pipe.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Erosions sounds scary leh. It's from the asid ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. You also have a small hiatus hernia, three centimetres. Part of the stomach slides up above the diaphragm, so acid escapes more easily.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Need operation for the hernia? Kena potong ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not for a small one. Kebanyakan orang okay dengan ubat and lifestyle changes saja.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll give you esomeprazole 40mg once a day, before breakfast, for eight weeks. Then we step down.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last time the klinik gave me ranitidine, tak jalan pun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Esomeprazole is stronger than ranitidine. Take it every day, not only when there's pain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Diet wise? I do a lot of makan-makan with clients, beer and all.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alcohol, big late meals and extra weight all make it worse. Your BMI is 28, losing even five kilos helps a lot.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright, I'll try to kurangkan the beer. Can I still minum kopi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: One cup pagi is fine. The biopsy showed no Barrett's changes, so no need to repeat the scope unless symptoms berubah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, thanks doc. Lega already.

patient_persona.description: Ng Kok Wah, 56, male, electrician in Kuantan, Pahang; takes simvastatin 40mg at night. Plain-spoken Malaysian Mandarin, a few Malay and English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Li Ping, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, gastroenterologist at a Kuantan hospital, reviewing biopsy results. Precise, patient; Mandarin with English drug names.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 黄先生，你的 biopsy 报告出来了。十二指肠有一个溃疡，而且验到 H. pylori 细菌。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bacteria？那就是说我的胃痛是细菌引起的？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，大部分的十二指肠溃疡都是这个细菌造成的。你的血也有一点贫血，hemoglobin 11.2。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 难怪我最近爬楼梯很容易累。这个可以医好吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以。要吃三种药，十四天：omeprazole 20mg，amoxicillin 1 gram，clarithromycin 500mg，全部一天两次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那么多药啊？一天要吃几粒？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 早上饭前一套，晚上饭前一套。我会给你一张表，照着吃，一次都不要漏。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我晚上还有吃 simvastatin，那个胆固醇药，可以一起吃吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个很重要。Clarithromycin 跟 simvastatin 一起会伤肌肉。这十四天 simvastatin 先停，吃完抗生素再吃回。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，stop 两个星期。吃药会有什么 side effect？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 嘴巴可能有 metallic taste，也可能 diarrhoea。If 拉得很严重 or 皮肤出 rash，马上回来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我老婆也要 check 吗？我们一起吃饭的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 她没有症状就不用。你吃完药之后四个星期，我们做 breath test，看细菌有没有清。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个 breath test 之前要注意什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Test 前两个星期停 omeprazole，前一晚 midnight 后 fasting。贫血的话，我另外开 iron tablets 给你。

patient_persona.description: Mak Som (Puan Kalsom binti Daud), 58, female, nasi kerabu seller from Pasir Mas, Kelantan; buys painkillers for knee pain from a sundry shop. Talkative, strong Kelantan dialect.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Syafiq Ab Rahman, Malay man in his 30s, medical officer at a Pasir Mas health clinic. Kind, direct; Kelantan-friendly Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, perut ambo pedih sangat dua minggu ni. Semalam berak hitam, macam tar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Black stool tu important, mak cik. Berapa kali dah jadi macam tu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Semalam dua kali, pagi tadi sekali. Rasa pening bila bangun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik ada makan ubat sakit sendi, painkiller dari kedai?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ado. Ubat sakit lutut, beli kedai runcit. Makan tiga kali sehari, dah sebulan lebih.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik bawa kotak ubat tu? Ni diclofenac, an NSAID. Ubat jenis ni boleh buat ulcer dalam perut dan bleeding.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Allah, ambo tak tahu pun. Ingat ubat angin je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nadi mak cik 110, blood pressure 98/60, muka pucat. Hemoglobin cepat tadi 8.4, rendah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya rasa ada ulser yang berdarah, bleeding ulcer. Mak cik kena pergi Hospital Pasir Mas sekarang, ambulance akan hantar.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena tahan wad ko? Anak ambo kerja kat KL.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, kena admit. Doktor sana akan buat scope, tengok dan stop the bleeding kalau perlu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat lutut tu, ambo nak buang terus ko?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, jangan makan lagi. Untuk lutut, paracetamol lebih selamat. Nanti lepas keluar wad kita bincang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baiklah doktor. Ambo telefon suami dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Sementara tunggu, nil by mouth, jangan makan atau minum apa-apa, sebab mungkin kena buat endoscopy.

patient_persona.description: Arun a/l Mahendran, 35, male, logistics coordinator in Johor Bahru, returning after H. pylori treatment. Friendly, fast Malaysian Indian English, some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chin Soo Yee, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP in Johor Bahru. Upbeat, efficient; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Arun, you're here for the breath test result, right?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes doctor. I did the test last Jumaat at the lab, the one where you tiup into the bag.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good news. The urea breath test is negative. The H. pylori is gone.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wah, finally. Those two weeks of ubat were terrible, my mouth rasa macam besi the whole time.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Clarithromycin does that. Did you stop the omeprazole two weeks before the test like we said?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, stopped. But the last few days a bit of pedih came back, only after nasi lemak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mild burning after oily food is common. Ada muntah, black stools, or weight loss?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: None of that. Berat actually same, 74 kilos.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. You can take omeprazole 20mg when needed, maybe for a few weeks, then stop.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can the kuman come back?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Reinfection in adults is uncommon, maybe one to two percent a year. Good hygiene and clean water help.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My father also had ulser last time. Should he test also?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If he has symptoms, yes. He can see his GP and ask for a breath test or stool antigen test.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And painkillers? Sometimes I makan Ponstan for sakit kepala.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ponstan is an NSAID, better avoid since you had an ulcer. Makan Panadol saja, dua biji, sampai empat kali sehari.

patient_persona.description: Pak Long Ismail bin Kassim, 67, male, retired fisherman from Muar, Johor; admitted two days ago for a bleeding gastric ulcer. Hoarse, slow, Johor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kelvin Lau Seng Chuan, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, surgical registrar at a Muar hospital, on morning ward round. Efficient, respectful; fluent Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, pak cik. Macam mana perut hari ni? Masih sakit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah kurang, doktor. Semalam masih berak hitam sikit, pagi ni belum lagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Masa skop hari tu, kami jumpa ulser dalam perut, dua sentimeter. Kami dah klip saluran darah yang berdarah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Klip tu kekal dalam perut ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak, klip tu akan tercabut sendiri dalam beberapa minggu dan keluar dengan najis. Pak cik tak rasa apa-apa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hemoglobin semalam 8.1, lepas dua beg darah naik ke 9.6. Blood pressure 124/74, nadi 84, stabil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh makan nasi? Dah dua hari minum air je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Today boleh start bubur dan soft diet. Kalau tak ada muntah darah, tomorrow boleh makan biasa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat yang masuk tangan ni, ubat apa, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tu pantoprazole, untuk reduce acid supaya ulser sembuh. Esok kita tukar ke oral tablet, 40mg twice a day untuk lapan minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Biopsi tu dah keluar result ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biopsi positif H. pylori, jadi pak cik perlu antibiotik juga. Tak ada tanda kanser, tapi kita ulang skop lapan minggu lagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya selalu makan aspirin, doktor klinik yang bagi untuk jantung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aspirin kita tahan dulu. Saya bincang dengan doktor jantung bila boleh mula semula, mungkin dalam seminggu.

patient_persona.description: Wong Siew Ching, 44, female, bank officer in Kuching, Sarawak; allergic to penicillin. Soft, careful Sarawak Mandarin with English banking words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Abang Azhar Abang Hamdan, Sarawakian Malay man in his 40s, gastroenterologist in Kuching. Courteous; English-leaning, speaks passable Mandarin and switches when needed.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Miss Wong，你的 gastroscopy 看到胃发炎，biopsy 有 H. pylori。我们今天讨论治疗。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的医生。可是我对 penicillin 敏感，以前吃 amoxicillin 全身起红点，喉咙很痒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢谢你讲，这个很重要。那我们不用 amoxicillin，换成 metronidazole。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 所以你吃三样药，十四天：omeprazole 20mg，clarithromycin 500mg，metronidazole 400mg，全部一天两次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Metronidazole 要注意什么吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃这个药的时候，还有吃完后两天，绝对不可以喝酒，会很晕很想吐。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我不喝酒的。不过下个月公司有 annual dinner。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那时候你已经吃完了，没问题。你现在还有吃其他药吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 只有 Zyrtec，鼻子敏感的时候吃，还有月经痛吃 Ponstan。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Zyrtec 可以。Ponstan 会伤胃，这段时间换 Panadol。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我妈妈以前是胃癌走的，我这个会不会变成癌？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 biopsy 没有癌细胞。清除 H. pylori 反而可以减少胃癌的风险，所以这个治疗很值得。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那吃完药以后呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃完四个星期后做 breath test。因为你有 family history，one year later 我们再做一次 scope 看看。
